desc.zh: 把重叠矩形切成竖条，用区间合并计算覆盖高度。
desc.en: Slice overlapping rectangles into strips and merge their covered heights.

complexity: O(n² log n) time; O(n) auxiliary space

concepts.name: vertical slabs
concepts.description: Coverage is constant between consecutive x edges.

concepts.name: interval union invariant
concepts.description: Sorted intervals add only the uncovered suffix.
